scene: home dinner party table: platter of breaded schnitzels, glass bowl of tagliatelle, bowl of salad with feta, ramekin of dip, two glasses of rose
user_note: Everything on this table is mine.
notes: The user-line branch of the nearest-setting rule. Without the line the prompt is explicitly right to report only the near plate, so this case has no defined answer without it; with the line the answer is the whole table. The measures are therefore what is ON the table — the full pasta bowl, the whole platter — and not the share the person ate, because the model is reading a photograph and cannot be asked to guess an appetite. In the app that gap closes on the other side: the person resizes the shared rows down in Meal Edit. Schnitzel count is the platter as visible and is approximate; counts are reported, not gated.
